name: Управление организациями и заявки
changes: Unsaved-edit close confirmation with actual draft equality; unchanged edits close directly.
Synchronous view and model submit guards cover rules acceptance, save and navigation.
Workspace rows/counters survive failed refresh; failed page retries its own cursor; new query/account rejects stale data.
Child news/events/team/public-detail routes receive parent repositories. Confirmed saves update the management authority snapshot.
Team changes reload the exact organization rather than the entire catalog.
Photo refresh generation/content revision prevents a stale read from restoring deleted photos.
Organization review locks submitted decision/reason while processing.
Wizard resets scroll between steps and stacks actions at accessibility sizes; edit-specific copy; unknown counts display a dash.

localDataflow.note: Unit tests only; initial UI selectors used wrong class and were corrected in subsequent bundles.

uiAttempts.note: Edit save/reopen, German AX nested windows, org role matrix and review/history passed. Driver hit keyboard in create and search routes.
Search/content and admin/warned/blocked/guest passed. City identifier matched an icon; changed query to TextField.
Creation, rules, persisted request and preview passed; driver expected alert instead of native popover on withdrawal.

evidence.rulesEnvironmentCorrection: Initial 41 pass/13 fail was caused by mismatched primary emulator project for Storage cross-service reads; same rules passed with the required demo project.
static: 3296 uk/de localization entries and Swift references passed

finalRegression.cases: Seven new dataflow regression tests plus complete create/preview/withdraw and German dark AX nested windows.

changes: Exact organization refresh after team mutation

boundaries: No measured production latency improvement claimed.

limitations: UI legal acceptance is a DEBUG simulator fixture; actual acceptance contracts verified separately in isolated server tests.
Photo picker/crop/upload on physical iPhone remains a manual gate.
Notification records verified; actual two-device APNs delivery not exercised.
Maximum AX5 and every language/theme cross-product not exercised in this block.
General moderation belongs to block 10; shared content editors to blocks 5 and 6.
